Lucide icon subset — lucide-static v1.70.0

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.70.0.tgz
Project: https://lucide.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Vendored icons: arrow-right, book-open, code, copy, external-link, menu, search, x.
SVG path data is unchanged from the release. The SVG wrappers are adapted into
Django Cotton components in website/templates/cotton/icons/. The shared base
component provides sizing, currentColor, stroke width, and accessibility attrs.

The full upstream LICENSE is preserved in LICENSE.txt (ISC plus MIT notices
for Feather-derived icons). These third-party icons retain their own licenses;
they are not covered by the project's original-code license grant.

No browser CDN, JavaScript icon replacement, icon font, or npm icon package is
required. To add icons, vendor paths from a pinned official Lucide release,
retain the upstream license, and add a wrapper using the shared base component.
